children: is pleased to provide an update on construction at its Los Ricos South project in Jalisco, Mexico. The project is progressing on schedule, and the Company reiterates first silver pour in the second quarter of 2028.

"Construction at Los Ricos South continues to progress according to plan with site clearing and earthworks about halfway complete," said Brad Langille, President and CEO. "Reflecting on recent volatility in the precious metals, it is good to note that our project is a very high margin project, which is less impacted by a decrease in metal price than most. Our very strong balance sheet and substantial cash flows generated at our operating mine in Parral further derisks the project and we do not foresee any need for future equity or debt offerings to complete the project. Based on internal estimates using $45/oz silver, we see our cash reserves maintaining a minimum of US$100 million over the course of the build."
– Site clearing and earthworks at the process plant site are approximately 48% complete with 180 contractor personnel on site.

– All long-lead equipment orders have been placed, with procurement continuing on schedule. The long-lead orders include the SAG mill, tailings filter, crusher, electrical switchgear, Merrill-Crowe plant, conveyors, slurry pumps, hydrocyclones, feeders and screens and paste plant pumps.
– the design by M3 and DENM Engineering is 95% complete. Vendor design specifications being inputted to the finals design.
– the design is being carried out by RMS of Sudbury, Canada. The current progress will allow the start of construction in January 2027.
– Cominvi planned to mobilize to site in Q4 2026. Portal designs have been completed by WSP and associated earthworks have begun.
– Construction and procurement remain on or ahead of plan, with first silver pour reiterated for Q2 2028.
To date, the Company has spent US$21 million on the project, with US$52 million committed to date. Following are the key schedule milestones:
Los Ricos South Key Schedule Milestones
Underground mine plan optimization commenced – August 2026
Hill-slope stabilization / mining – Main/Abra zone – March 2027
SAG mill delivery to site – May 2027

Technical information contained in this news release with respect to GoGold has been reviewed and approved by Mr. Bob Harris, P.Eng., who is a non-independent qualified person for the purposes of NI 43-101.

is a Canadian-based silver and gold producer focused on operating, developing, exploring and acquiring high quality projects in Mexico.
